customer_transcript: Hello, Hi ma'am, I saw your ad about your project online. Honestly speaking, it was very impressive. Especially that OMR location. It's superb. Yes, I am definitely watching it. Actually, I have been planning for a long time. And when I saw it in your project visuals, I got interested. The layout is very clean. Not congested at all. Was it 2BHK or 3BHK? Mostly 2BHK. For family it's enough. And I saw that balcony space. It was very nice. It gave an open feel. Exactly! That's what I also noticed. Nowadays, many flats don't have that open feel, but you have maintained it well in your project. We can definitely do it. Actually, I am nearby. I thought of planning it in the coming weekend. Oh, that's perfect sir. I can align the site for you. Super. Before that, tell me some details like price range, EMI options and handover time. Okay, actually mom, I'll be honest with you. I really like the project, genuinely, but my budget is a bit limited. Max to max, I have planned 35 to 40 lakhs, so it will be difficult if I stretch more than that. No, no. I am hesitating to take a loan. I already have a few commitments. So, I decided not to take any risk. The project is very good. If the budget is adjusted, I will definitely consider it. Yes, yes, please. That would be helpful. Maybe if the situation improves in the future, we can definitely revisit it. Thanks a lot, ma'am. You explained the details clearly. Really appreciate it. Okay, ma'am. I'll stay in touch with you. Thank you.

retrieved_context.text: Customer discussed budget around 50 lakhs, asked for site visit, and wanted to buy within 2 months. Final intent: High.
Customer casually explored location and amenities with no budget or visit intent. Final intent: Low.
Customer asked about loan and availability but did not commit to visit. Final intent: Medium.
If customer only casually explores amenities or location without budget or visit intent, lower intent confidence.
If customer explicitly mentions budget, site visit, or immediate purchase timeline, raise intent confidence.
If customer asks about loan or availability but avoids commitment, assign medium intent.

reasoning: The customer showed high initial interest, praising the project's location, layout, and features, and expressed a long-term plan to buy a property.
The customer committed to a site visit for the coming weekend and actively asked for specific details regarding price range, EMI options, and handover time, indicating serious intent.

A significant budget mismatch (customer's max 35-40 lakhs vs. project's 55 lakhs) combined with an explicit refusal to take a loan due to existing commitments presents a major obstacle for proceeding with this specific project.

Despite the budget and loan issues, the customer expressed continued strong interest in the project itself ('If the budget is adjusted, I will definitely consider it') and agreed to be updated on offers, maintaining a warm lead for future opportunities.
learning_insight: The agent effectively captured customer interest and secured a site visit commitment, demonstrating strong initial sales progress.

The significant budget mismatch and firm loan refusal for the current project highlight the importance of either having alternative properties within the customer's stated budget or identifying potential future offers/discounts to re-engage.

Even when immediate closure on a specific property is unlikely due to budget constraints, maintaining an open line of communication for future offers or different projects can retain a highly engaged and motivated lead.
